title: Gift of Pure Thought
wikitext:
{{Spellpage|

| spellname = Gift of Pure Thought
| spellicon = H
| description = Calms your group's thoughts, allowing them to regenerate mana more quickly. This spell is identical to [[Clarity II]], but it affects your whole group.

Also, as an added point of information, everyone in a group within appropriate physical range regardless of level can receive any group buff, so long as the caster does not have a lower level targeted when trying to cast the spell. Meaning, a level 1 can receive this buff.

Extra Cool Move: By Default, F7 targets the nearest player. When casting a GROUP BUFF, target yourself, then while the spell is casting hit F7 and it will land on that player AND their group regardless of level. This comes from a level 60 druid using the Regen Clicky and PoTG on low level groups all the time.
